settings.title: What is Cross-Linked Polyethylene EVA?
settings.text: Cross-Linked Polyethylene EVA (Ethylene Vinyl Acetate) is a high-quality type of foam material, known for its exceptional durability and resilience. This foam is chemically cross-linked, resulting in a closed-cell structure that provides superior performance, enhanced longevity, and excellent shock absorption.
